# One launch system. Drones from any vendor.

Nemyx VLS

A modular launcher for high-volume commercial drones, strike drones and interceptors from multiple manufacturers. One point of launch for an evolving fleet.

[Discover Nemyx VLS](https://auterion.com/product/nemyx-vls/) [Get in touch with our team](https://auterion.com/company/contact-us/)

Long Range One Way Attack

## Scalable Deep Strike Capability

Auterion’s Long Range One Way Attack capability delivers precision effects at distances of up to 1,000 miles andcombines combat-tested hardware with Auterion’s open, software-defined autonomy stack to deliver resilient, scalable strike capability.

## Nemyx: Coordinated swarms at scale

Swarm autonomy. Built on AuterionOS. Scalable, mission-focused.

[Learn more about Auterion Nemyx](https://auterion.com/product/nemyx/) [Get in touch with our team](https://auterion.com/company/contact-us/)

Skynode X

## Autonomy. Integrated.  Ready to deploy.

Skynode X is the fastest path from airframe to autonomous operations with the Auterion platform.

One tightly integrated compute and autopilot system for mission planning, real-time video, fleet operations, and continuous flight analytics. **Built for teams that need reliable autonomy — not another stack to assemble.** Deploy smarter workflows, stream data live, and close the loop with cloud-based insights and predictive maintenance.

[Start flying autonomous](https://auterion.com/product/skynode-x/)

[Explore AI Node for Skynode X](https://auterion.com/?page_id=16281)

![](https://i0.wp.com/auterion.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/auterion-skynode-x-power-autonomy.png?resize=1080%2C608&ssl=1)

AuterionOS

### The operating system for autonomous robots.

AuterionOS runs onboard and connects your entire fleet.

Vendor-independent by design, built on open standards, and ready for continuous deployment in the field.

[Discover AuterionOS](https://auterion.com/product/auterion-os/)

Auterion Suite

### From flight data to operational intelligence.

Visualize data transferred automatically to the cloud and process information captured during a mission in real time, including flight logs. Benefit from a holistic and scalable fleet management.

[Discover Suite](https://auterion.com/product/suite/)

Auterion Mission Control

### One interface for every vehicle. Every mission.

Plan, execute, and monitor operations from a single application — whether you’re flying one drone or coordinating a global fleet.

[Discover Mission Control](https://auterion.com/product/mission-control/)
